About RNGdle - Daily Random Number Badge Game

Reviewed and updated by the RNGdle Editorial Team. 2026-08-02.

About RNGdle

RNGdle is a compact browser game about making one random number feel meaningful. The game rolls a number, finds numerical patterns, assigns badges, and turns those discoveries into EP.

This project is a static remake of the core play experience. It focuses on account sign-in, local daily progress, badge scoring, and shareable roll summaries.

What this remake includes

The remake includes a daily roll, UTC reset countdown, local lifetime EP, rarity tiers, badge families, and a broad set of number-pattern checks.

It includes live account login and registration, but not server leaderboards, social hearts, claim tokens, or friend feeds.

Editorial and contact details

RNGdle content is reviewed by the RNGdle Editorial Team before publication, with updates tracked through the site modification date.

Questions, corrections, or feedback about RNGdle can be sent to hello@rngdle.org.
